lines: d39: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Meera Joshi is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d39: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d39: 🕯️ Meera is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d39: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d39: 🕯️ Meera Joshi is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d39: What Meera kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d39: "Meera's gone." Thao looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Meera." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d39: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Megan blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d39: 📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
d39: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d39: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d39: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Meera Joshi, 39 days. The mantle passes to Megan Mancini.
d39: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Megan Mancini, 35 — an emergency dispatcher. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm.
d39: The village's quarrel was with Meera — and Meera is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d39: At the grave, Paul, Thao, Adil and 4 more speak for Megan — "Meera trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d39: The fire knew Megan before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
